Udyr|jgl.identity: Mixed damage fighter who switches between four stances, all of which can be ranked up to 5 (R included). Wilding Claw (Q) boosts his attack speed and strikes with lightning, Iron Mantle (W) gives a shield and lifesteal, Blazing Stampede (E) speeds him up and makes his next attack on each target stun, and Wingborne Storm (R) creates a storm that slows around him. After every stance, his next two attacks are empowered, and he can awaken a stance to make it stronger.
Udyr|jgl.playstyle: Very fast-clearing jungler built for invades and duels. Udyr can lean his damage on Q (physical, dueling) or R (magic, area). He's strong in skirmishes and ganks thanks to E's stun.
Udyr|jgl.early_game: Clear fast, switching stances to make the most of your empowered attacks. Invade when your laners have priority: you win a lot of duels. Gank with E: speed up, then stun the target with your next attack.
Udyr|jgl.level_2: Wingborne Storm (R). In most games, Udyr takes R very early for area clearing.
Udyr|jgl.level_3: Iron Mantle (W). A shield and lifesteal: your clear gets safer. Blazing Stampede (E) comes at level 4 on the most common path, and your ganks come with it.
Udyr|jgl.level_6: Udyr has no classic ultimate: level 6 strengthens your stances (mostly Q or R depending on your build). Your duels and clear get stronger.
power_spikes: Level 4: Blazing Stampede, ganks with a stun.
First completed item: very strong duels.
Awakened stances: burst or area depending on your build.
Udyr|jgl.jungle_plan: Very fast clear and invades. Udyr wants to dominate the jungle: steal enemy camps, control Scuttles and take Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) when your laners have priority. Gank with E from level 4, and play dragons with your team.
Udyr|jgl.trading: Ganking: E to speed up → stunning attack → Q or R → W for the shield. Dueling: switch stances to make the most of your empowered attacks. Give up on it against champions who kite you (Ivern) or lock you down for a long time (Zac).
threats: Heavy CC that breaks your combos.
mistakes: Staying in one stance and losing your empowered attacks.
Using E with no target to stun.
Choosing your build without looking at the enemy comp.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: Duel him with your empowered attacks.
matchup_notes.Viego: Stun him with E when he dives.
matchup_notes.Ivern: He doesn't fight: set the pace with your laners.
matchup_notes.Zac: He soaks damage and locks you down: avoid long fights.

Udyr|jgl.late_game: Dive the enemy backline with E and stun the carry.
Udyr|jgl.ahead: Choke out the enemy jungler and force fights.
Udyr|jgl.behind: Farm fast and play with your team.
Udyr|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to dominate the jungle through farming and invades, then win skirmishes.
Udyr|jgl.final_tip: Switch stances: every switch empowers your next two attacks.
